4. The case of the petitioners in short, are that, the suit originally belonged to Neamath Mondal and accordingly RoR Khatian No.53 was recorded in his name: that Neamath Mondal died leaving behind four sons namely—Nabi Hossain, Ujir Mamood, Najir Mamood, Latu Mondal and on amicable partition Nabi Hossain got the same; that Nabi Hossain died leaving behind only son Taleh Hossain. Taleh Hossain have been possessing the suit land. Thereafter Taleh Hossain died leaving behind the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs have been possessing the suit land by paying rents. Due to flood the suit land is lying as abandoned and taking the opportunity the defendants entered the suit land on 12-8-2004 and sowed paddy. Hence, the plaintiffs filed the instant suit. 

 5. The defendant Nos. 1, 2 and 5 contested the suit by filing joint written statement denying all the material allegations of the plaint contending, inter alia that Jogendra Chandra Lal and others became the owner of the entire property of the suit plot by way of purchase from Nemath Mondal. A road has gone across the suit plot from east to west since long days before. The land of the case plot along with other lands of different plot were recorded in the name of Jogendra Chandra Lal and others in RoR Khatian but beyond their knowledge the suit property was recorded in the name of the plaintiffs. Aaradhan Sheel and others as heir of Jogendra Sheel became the owner of suit land. Subsequently, Nowsher Ali, Azim, Monej son of Najir Mamood threatened Aaradhan Sheel and others to disposes from suit land and in this regard a salish was held and as per decision of salish, Azim Uddin and others executed a deed of Nadabi in favour of Aarardhan Afterwards, Aarardhan sold the suit land along with other lands i.e 15 decimals to the defendant No.1 and also sold the rest of land of suit plot to the defendant Nos.2 by way of registered deed No.2188 dated 11-5-2003 and deed No.2187 dated 11-5-2003 respectively. The defendant Nos. l and 2 have been possessing the entire suit plot for more than 12 years. The defendant No.1 transferred some land from his purchased land through heba in favour of mosque. With these averments the defendants prayed to dismiss the suit.
